glossary.κτερεΐξαι: κτερεΐζω (= κτερίζω) — pay funeral honours to, perform funeral rites for; aor. inf., used as imperative
glossary.κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’)
glossary.λήσομαι: λανθάνομαι — forget; fut. 1 sg. + gen.: ’I will forget’
glossary.λιλαιόμενόν: λιλαίομαι — desire eagerly, be eager for; pres. part. masc. acc. sg. + gen.: ’eager for’
glossary.λοεσσάμενός: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic λοεσσάμενος: ’having bathed’
glossary.μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’
glossary.μάκαρός: μάκαρ — blessed, fortunate, happy; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’
glossary.μάρτυροι: μάρτυς — witness; nom. pl., epic μάρτυροι (= Attic μάρτυρες)
glossary.μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μέγαρον: μέγαρον — hall, main room of the house; acc. sg.
glossary.μέλλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμελλεν), + inf.: ’was on course to be’
glossary.μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
glossary.μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ)
glossary.μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μελέτω: μέλω — be a care, be a concern; pres. imper. 3 sg. impersonal: ’let it be a care’
glossary.μενέλαον: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; acc. sg.
glossary.μερμερίδαο: Μερμερίδης — son of Mermerus, patronymic of Ilus; gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μετέλθοι: μετέρχομαι — come among, go to join; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’should come among (them)’
glossary.μεταλλᾷς: μεταλλάω — inquire after, ask about; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; neg. conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ)
glossary.μητέρ: μήτηρ — mother; acc. sg., elided (μητέρ’ = μητέρα)
glossary.μητιόωντες: μητιάω — devise, plan, contrive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μητιῶντες)
glossary.μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg.
glossary.νέστορα: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; acc. sg.
glossary.νήσοισιν: νῆσος — island; dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.νεμεσίζετο: νεμεσίζομαι — feel righteous anger, stand in awe of; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.: ’stood in awe of’
glossary.νεμεσσήσαιτό: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid. νεμεσσήσαιτο (double σ metri gratia), with κε: ’would be indignant’
glossary.νηπιάας: νηπιέη — childishness, childish thing; acc. pl. νηπιάας (from νήπιος ’child, fool’): ’childish ways’
glossary.νοήσας: νοέω — perceive, understand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having perceived’
glossary.νοστήσας: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having returned’
glossary.νώνυμνον: νώνυμνος — nameless, without a name; fem./masc. acc. sg. (νη- ’not’ + ὄνυμα, epic for ὄνομα)
glossary.νῆ: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα, elided (νῆ’ = νῆα)
glossary.νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
glossary.ξανθὸν: ξανθός — yellow, tawny, fair (of hair); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ξείνοισι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; dat. pl. (epic = Attic ξένοις)
glossary.ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
glossary.ξυνίει: ξυνίημι — perceive, understand, attend to (= συνίημι, ξυν- epic for συν-); pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’attend!’
glossary.οἰχομένοιο: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone away; pres. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), perfect sense: ’gone’
glossary.οἴχετ: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. 3 sg., elided (οἴχετ’ = οἴχεται), perfect sense: ’is gone’
glossary.οἶδ: οἶδα — know; perf. 1 sg., elided (οἶδ’ = οἶδα) · also perf. 3 sg. (identical elided form): ’he/she knows’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ(ε) ’who knows’)
glossary.οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
glossary.οἷα: οἷος — such as, of what kind; neut. acc. pl., relative: ’such (things) as’
glossary.οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ (μετὰ οἷς ἑτάροισι ’among his own companions’)
glossary.οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg. correlative with τοῖος (τοῖος ἐὼν οἷόν μιν ’just such as when’)
glossary.οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
glossary.οὐκί: οὐ — not; emphatic form οὐκί: ’not’ (ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’)
glossary.πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πέφραδε: φράζω — point out, declare, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg., reduplicated (πέφραδε)
glossary.πίθηαι: πείθομαι — be persuaded, obey; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πίθῃ)
glossary.πίνοντά: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’drinking’
glossary.παιδί: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.παιδὸς: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. gen. sg. (φίλης ... παιδός ’a dear daughter’)
glossary.παναχαιοί: Παναχαιοί — all the Achaeans together (πᾶς + Ἀχαιοί); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
glossary.πατροφονῆα: πατροφονεύς — father-slayer, killer of one’s father; acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
glossary.πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
glossary.πευσόμενος: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire, ask; fut. part. masc. nom. sg., purpose: ’to learn of’
glossary.πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
glossary.πικρόγαμοί: πικρόγαμος — of bitter marriage (πικρός ’bitter’ + γάμος); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πινυτός: πινυτός — sensible, of sound mind; masc. nom. sg. (connected with πέπνυμαι)
glossary.ποιῆσαι: ποιέω — make, do; aor. inf.: ’to make (an end)’
glossary.πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’
glossary.ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
glossary.πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
glossary.πρώτῃσι: πρῶτος — first; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.πρῶτ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (πρῶτ’ = πρῶτα): ’first’
glossary.πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
glossary.πυκινῶς: πυκινός — close-packed, shrewd, well-considered; adv. πυκινῶς: ’shrewdly, closely’
glossary.πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
glossary.σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
glossary.σάμῃ: Σάμη — Same, an island near Ithaca; dat. sg.
glossary.σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
glossary.σκίδνασθαι: σκίδνημι — scatter, disperse; pres. inf. mid./pass.: ’to scatter’
glossary.σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
glossary.σπάρτηνδε: Σπάρτη — Sparta; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’to Sparta’
glossary.σταίη: ἵστημι — stand, make to stand; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would stand’
glossary.στεναχίζω: στεναχίζω — groan, wail; pres. 1 sg., epic
glossary.στυγερὸν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σφέτερα: σφέτερος — their own; neut. acc. pl.: ’their own (homes)’
glossary.σῆμά: σῆμα — sign, mark, grave-mound; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
glossary.τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
glossary.ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic
glossary.τεθνηῶτος: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. gen. sg., epic τεθνηώς (Attic τεθνεώς), with ἀκούω ’hear of’: ’that he is dead’
glossary.τελευτήσῃς: τελευτάω — finish, accomplish, bring to an end; aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.τελευτὴν: τελευτή — end, completion, conclusion; acc. sg. (τελευτὴν ποιῆσαι ’to bring to an end’)
glossary.τεοῖσι: τεός — your (sg.), of you; possessive adj., epic (Attic σός); masc./neut. dat. pl. -οισι (= Attic σοῖς)
glossary.τερπόμενόν: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. τέρπομαι take delight, enjoy oneself; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’taking his delight’
glossary.τεταρπόμενός: τέρπω — mid. τέρπομαι delight in, take one’s fill of; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’having taken his fill’
glossary.τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
glossary.τεύξουσι: τεύχω — make, make ready, prepare; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.τηλίκος: τηλίκος — of such an age, so old; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τιμῆεν: τιμήεις — precious, honoured; neut. nom./acc. sg., contracted τιμῆεν
glossary.τλαίης: τλῆναι (defective, root τλα-) — endure, bear, hold out; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you could endure’
glossary.τολύπευσεν: τολυπεύω — wind up, bring to completion (from τολύπη ’ball of wool’); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’wound up’ (of a war)
glossary.τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
glossary.τρυχόμενός: τρύχω — wear out, exhaust; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’worn down’
glossary.τρύχουσι: τρύχω — wear out, exhaust, consume; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.τόσσοι: τόσος — so many, so great; epic τόσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’so many’ (correlative with ὅσσοι)
glossary.τύμβον: τύμβος — burial mound, grave-mound; acc. sg.
glossary.τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’)
glossary.φάρμακον: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or deadly); acc. sg.
glossary.φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry; mid. pres. inf.: ’to carry off for oneself’
glossary.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’
glossary.φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι)
glossary.φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’)
glossary.φθινύθουσιν: φθινύθω — waste, consume, cause to waste away (epic lengthened form of φθίνω); pres. 3 pl. transitive: ’waste, consume’
glossary.φιλέεσκε: φιλέω — love, be fond of; impf. 3 sg., iterative in -σκ- (unaugmented): ’used to be fond of’
glossary.φράζεσθαι: φράζω — point out, tell; mid. φράζομαι consider, think out, devise; pres. inf. mid.: ’to consider’; also used as an imperative: ’consider!’
glossary.φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg.
glossary.φώς: φώς — man, hero (poetic word); nom. sg.
glossary.χαίρων: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rejoicing’
glossary.χαλκήρεας: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with tunic of bronze (χαλκός + χιτών); gen. pl.
glossary.χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.χεῦαι: χέω — pour, heap up; aor. inf., used as imperative: ’heap up’ (of a grave-mound)
glossary.χρίεσθαι: χρίω — anoint, smear; mid. pres. inf.: ’to smear (for oneself)’
glossary.χρεώ: χρεώ — need, necessity; nom. sg., impersonal noun (σε χρεώ ’there is need on you’)
glossary.χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
glossary.ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀκαχοίμην: ἀκαχίζω — grieve, be distressed; reduplicated aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I would grieve’
glossary.ἀκλειῶς: ἀκλεής — without fame, inglorious; adv. ἀκλειῶς, epic spelling (= Attic ἀκλεῶς): ’without fame’
glossary.ἀμοιβῆς: ἀμοιβή — exchange, return, requital; gen. sg. (ἄξιον ἀμοιβῆς ’worth a return’)
glossary.ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνέγνω: ἀναγιγνώσκω — know for certain, recognise; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀν-έ-γνω), gnomic
glossary.ἀνέρι: ἀνήρ — man, husband; dat. sg.: ’to a husband’
glossary.ἀναιδέσι: ἀναιδής — shameless (ἀν- + αἰδώς); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀνδροφόνον: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying, murderous (ἀνήρ + φόνος); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνείρεαι: ἀνείρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῃ)
glossary.ἀνερχομένῳ: ἀνέρχομαι — come back, return; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to me as I come back’
glossary.ἀνηρείψαντο: ἀνερείπομαι — snatch up and carry away; aor. 3 pl., augment inside the compound (ἀν-ηρείψαντο, ε lengthened to η)
glossary.ἀνθρώποισι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνιόντα: ἄνειμι — come back, go up; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’on his way back’
glossary.ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
glossary.ἀνόπαια: ἀνόπαια — meaning disputed: ’upward’, or ’unseen’, or (divided ἀν’ ὀπαῖα) ’up through the smoke-vent’, or the name of a bird; adv., hapax legomenon
glossary.ἀνώγῃ: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); subj. 3 sg.: ’may bid’
glossary.ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
glossary.ἀποιχομένου: ἀποίχομαι — be gone away, be absent; pres. part. masc. gen. sg.: ’gone away’
glossary.ἀποτίσεται: ἀποτίνω — pay back, make pay, exact requital; fut. mid. 3 sg. ’will exact payment’, or perh. short-vowel aor. subj. (the form does not decide)
glossary.ἀποτμότατος: ἄποτμος — ill-fated, unlucky (ἀ- + πότμος); superl., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπώσεαι: ἀπωθέω — thrust away, drive out; 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted, either fut. ’you will thrust away’ or short-vowel aor. subj. (the form does not decide)
glossary.ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρνεῖται: ἀρνέομαι — refuse, deny, say no to; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀρτυνέουσιν: ἀρτύνω — arrange, prepare, make ready; fut. 3 pl., epic uncontracted
glossary.ἀσχαλόωσι: ἀσχαλάω — be vexed, chafe, be impatient; pres. 3 pl., epic diectasis (= Attic ἀσχαλῶσι)
glossary.ἀφνειὸς: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
glossary.ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ (ἐπεὶ ἂρ δή ’since, as it seems’)
glossary.ἄιστον: ἄιστος — unseen, vanished without trace (ἀ- + root of ἰδεῖν); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄιστος: ἄιστος — unseen, vanished without trace; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄνωγα: ἄνωγα — bid, command, order; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I bid’
glossary.ἄνωχθι: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’bid! order!’
glossary.ἄξιον: ἄξιος — worth, worthy; neut. nom. sg., + gen.: ’worth (a return)’
glossary.ἄπυστος: ἄπυστος — unheard of, of whom nothing is learned (from root of πυνθάνομαι); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel
glossary.ἄρσας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, equip, fit out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fitted out’
glossary.ἅρπυιαι: Ἅρπυιαι — the Harpies, snatching storm-winds personified as beings that carry people off without trace (from ἁρπάζω); nom. pl.
glossary.ἐβόλοντο: βόλομαι — wish, will (epic by-form of βούλομαι); impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’willed’
glossary.ἐγείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’bore’
glossary.ἐλθὲ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
glossary.ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’from me’
glossary.ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
glossary.ἐμπάζεο: ἐμπάζομαι — heed, care for, take account of; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμπάζου), + gen.
glossary.ἐμός: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐμῶν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐνιαυτόν: ἐνιαυτός — year; acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’for a year’
glossary.ἐνόησα: νοέω — perceive, catch sight of, notice; aor. 1 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐπίμεινον: ἐπιμένω — wait, stay on, remain; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐπαλαστήσασα: ἐπαλαστέω — be indignant, be bitterly moved (rare verb, from ἄλαστος ’not to be forgotten’); aor. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπειγόμενός: ἐπείγω — press, urge on; mid./pass. ἐπείγομαι be in haste, press on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’pressing on (for the road)’
glossary.ἐπιδήμιος: ἐπιδήμιος — at home, in one’s own land (from δῆμος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπικρατέουσιν: ἐπικρατέω — hold power over, rule; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦσιν), + dat.
glossary.ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj.
glossary.ἐρέτῃσιν: ἐρέτης — rower, oarsman; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἐρεείνεις: ἐρεείνω — ask, question (epic, from ἔρομαι); pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
glossary.ἐφείη: ἐφίημι — send against, lay (hands) on; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would lay (his hands) on’
glossary.ἐφορμᾶται: ἐφορμάω — stir up, urge on; mid./pass. ἐφορμάομαι be roused, be set upon; pres. 3 sg.: ’is set upon, urges’
glossary.ἐφύρης: Ἐφύρη — Ephyra, name of several towns, not always identifiable; gen. sg.
glossary.ἐόντος: εἰμί — be; pres. part. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντος): ’being, alive’
glossary.ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
glossary.ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’
glossary.ἑοῖς: ἑός — his own, her own (by-form of the possessive ὅς); masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἑτέρως: ἕτερος — other, otherwise; adv. ἑτέρως: ’otherwise, the other way’
glossary.ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc./nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (δῶμα ἑὸν ’his own hall’)
glossary.ἔδοντες: ἔδω — eat (epic, = Attic ἐσθίω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’eating’
glossary.ἔεδνα: ἔεδνα — wedding gifts, bridal gifts (prothetic ἐ-, beside ἕδνα); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’)
glossary.ἔκτα: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., by-form ἔκτα (root aorist)
glossary.ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, win, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
glossary.ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’
glossary.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’
glossary.ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’ · also with ordinary past/aorist force: ’came to be, arose’ (τοῦτο νόημα ἔπλετο ’this thought has arisen’)
glossary.ἔρανος: ἔρανος — a meal to which each guest contributes his share (as against a feast given by a host); nom. sg.
glossary.ἔρξῃς: ἔρδω — do, work, accomplish (= ῥέζω); aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
glossary.ἔσσ: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic ἔσσο, elided (ἔσσ’ = ἔσσο; = Attic ἴσθι): ’be!’
glossary.ἔστων: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 pl.: ’let them be’
glossary.ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
glossary.ἔτετμε: τέτμον (defective) — come upon, overtake; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’overtook’
glossary.ἔτευξαν: τεύχω — make, fashion, cause; aor. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕπεσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany, go with; pres. inf.: ’to go with, accompany’
glossary.ἠδέ: ἠδέ — and; epic conjunction, accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἡμετέρῳ: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’
glossary.ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
glossary.ἤρατ: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); mid. win, gain for oneself; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἤρατ’ = ἤρατο): ’won’; in sense the aorist of ἄρνυμαι ’win’, under which some lexica file it
glossary.ἥρωας: ἥρως — hero, man of rank or noble birth; acc. pl.
glossary.ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε in ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’
glossary.ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
glossary.ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴλου: Ἶλος — Ilus, son of Mermerus, in Ephyra; gen. sg.
glossary.ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let her go’
glossary.ὀίσατο: ὀίομαι — think, suppose, imagine; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
glossary.ὀδύνας: ὀδύνη — pain, grief, anguish; acc. pl.
glossary.ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv.
glossary.ὀχέειν: ὀχέω — carry, keep up, uphold; pres. inf., epic uncontracted: ’to carry on, keep up (childish ways)’
glossary.ὀψιγόνων: ὀψίγονος — late-born, born in later generations; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ὁδοῖο: ὁδός — road, way, journey; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὁμιλήσειεν: ὁμιλέω — be in company with, meet, consort with; aor. opt. 3 sg., wish: ’might he come among’
glossary.ὁρόω: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg., epic stretched form (= Attic ὁρῶ)
glossary.ὁρόων: ὁράω — see; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic stretched (= Attic ὁρῶν): ’seeing’
glossary.ὄσσαν: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report (personified, from Zeus); acc. sg.
glossary.ὄφελον: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ὤφελον), with an infinitive, an unattainable wish: ’would that...’
glossary.ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
glossary.ὅμιλος: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng, gathering; nom. sg.
glossary.ὅππως: ὅπως — how, in what way; epic ὅππως (double π metri gratia), with κε + subj. (or fut.): ’how you are to…’
glossary.ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’as many as’
glossary.ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’ (correlative with τόσσοι)
glossary.ὑβρίζοντες: ὑβρίζω — act violently or insolently, commit outrage (from ὕβρις); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’behaving insolently’
glossary.ὑπέμνησέν: ὑπομιμνῄσκω — remind; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ὑπ-έ-μνησεν), + gen.: ’made mindful of’
glossary.ὑποθήσομαι: ὑποτίθημι — suggest, advise, put before; fut. mid. 1 sg.: ’I will advise’
glossary.ὠκύμοροί: ὠκύμορος — swift-doomed, early-doomed (ὠκύς + μόρος); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
glossary.ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl.: ’in his own (mind)’ (φρεσὶν ᾗσι)
glossary.ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
glossary.ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’)
glossary.ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
glossary.αἰθομένας: αἴθω/αἴθομαι — burn, blaze; pres. part. mid. fem. acc. pl. (agreeing with δαΐδας): ’burning’
glossary.αἴτιοι: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.αἴτιος: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, soon, at once; adv.
glossary.αὐδήν: αὐδή — voice, human speech; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in voice’ · also as the direct object of a verb of hearing (θεοῦ ἔκλυεν αὐδήν ’heard the voice of the god’)
glossary.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’
glossary.αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’
glossary.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’)
glossary.αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
glossary.βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’cast’
glossary.βίηφιν: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental case in -φι(ν) (= dat. βίῃ): ’by force’
glossary.βασιλευέμεν: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; pres. inf., epic ending -έμεν (= Attic βασιλεύειν)
glossary.βασιλεύσει: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.βασιλῆα: βασιλεύς — king; acc. sg., epic βασιλῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
glossary.βασιλῆες: βασιλεύς — king; nom. pl., epic βασιλῆες (= Attic βασιλεῖς)
glossary.βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, went’
glossary.βλεφάροισι: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.βοητὺς: βοητύς — shouting, clamor, din; fem. nom. sg., rare noun from βοάω
glossary.βούλευε: βουλεύω — plan, deliberate, ponder; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβούλευε)
glossary.γέ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle, accented γέ before a following enclitic
glossary.γενεὴ: γενεή — birth, lineage, descent; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γενεῇ: γενεή — birth, lineage, descent; fem. dat. sg.: ’by birth’
glossary.γνώμεναι: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognize; epic inf. in -μεναι: ’to be known’
glossary.γραίης: γραῦς — old woman; fem. gen. sg., epic γραίης
glossary.γυναικός: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive with δῖα: ’heavenly-one of women’
glossary.δέδμητο: δέμω — build; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been built’
glossary.δαινύμενοι: δαίνυμι — feast; mid. pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’feasting’
glossary.δακρύσασα: δακρύω — weep, shed tears; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having burst into tears’
glossary.δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.δαῖτας: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.διδόντος: δίδωμι — give; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., genitive absolute: ’Zeus granting it’
glossary.δμώων: δμώς — slave, bondman (esp. war-captive); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.δμῳάων: δμῳή — slave-woman, bondwoman; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)

glossary.ἐπετείλατο: ἐπιτέλλω — lay a charge upon, ordain; aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπιβώσομαι: ἐπιβοάομαι — call upon, invoke; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐπικλείουσ: ἐπικλείω — extol, make famous; pres. 3 pl., elided (ἐπικλείουσ’ = ἐπικλείουσι)
glossary.ἐπιτολμάτω: ἐπιτολμάω — have the endurance for; pres. imper. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐποίχεσθαι: ἐποίχομαι — go about, ply (a task); pres. inf.
glossary.ἐρίηρον: ἐρίηρος — trusty, well-fitted; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρχομένοιο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐτάνυσσεν: τανύω — stretch, draw tight; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
glossary.ἐῴκει: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. with impf. force, 3 sg.
glossary.ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑλλάδα: Ἑλλάς — Hellas, here a district of Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑνὸς: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑοῖσιν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’
glossary.ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη)
glossary.ἔκδυνε: ἐκδύω — strip off, take off (clothing); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’
glossary.ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἔμικτο: μίγνυμι — mingle, unite sexually; plpf. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔνθετο: ἐντίθημι — put in, lay to (heart); aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
glossary.ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’)
glossary.ἔσομ: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., elided (ἔσομ’ = ἔσομαι)
glossary.ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
glossary.ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be’ · also as a copula with a predicate, personal: ’let (no one) be (gentle, etc.)’ (μή τις … πρόφρων … ἔστω ’let no one be ready-minded’)
glossary.ἔτρεφε: τρέφω — rear, nurse, bring up; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ἔχοις: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. opt. 2 sg. (wish): ’may you keep’
glossary.ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἕν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’
glossary.ἠρήσαντο: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; aor. mid. 3 pl.
glossary.ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
glossary.ἡδὺν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἡμετέροιο: ἡμέτερος — our; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἤρχετο: ἄρχομαι — begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’began (to speak)’
glossary.ἥατ: ἧμαι — sit; epic perf./impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, elided (ἥατ’ = ἥατο, Attic ἧντο)
glossary.ἰδυῖα: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. nom. sg., here ’skilled, wise’
glossary.ἰκαρίοιο: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱμάντι: ἱμάς — strap, thong; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἱμερόεσσαν: ἱμερόεις — lovely, desirable; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
glossary.ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα)
glossary.ἶσα: ἴσος — equal; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’equally’
glossary.ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth; adv. (ὀδὰξ ἐν χείλεσι φύντες ’having bitten their lips’)
glossary.ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. mid. inf.
glossary.ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁμάδησαν: ὁμαδέω — make a din, clamor; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ὁππόθεν: ὁππόθεν — from where; epic indirect interrog. adv. (= Attic πόθεν)
glossary.ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’)
glossary.ὄλοισθε: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. opt. 2 pl. (wish, curse): ’may you perish’
glossary.ὄρνυται: ὄρνυμαι — be stirred, be roused; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὅππῃ: ὅππῃ — in whatever way, wherever; epic relative adv. (= Attic ὅπῃ)
glossary.ὑμὰ: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.); neut. acc. pl., epic short form ὑμά (= Attic ὑμέτερα): ’your own’
glossary.ὑπέμεινε: ὑπομένω — wait, hold one’s ground; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ὑπέρβιον: ὑπέρβιος — overweening, excessive; fem./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑπερωιόθεν: ὑπερῷον — upper story, upper chamber; adv. ὑπερωιόθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’from upstairs’
glossary.ὑπερῷ: ὑπερῷον — upper story, upper chamber; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὑπερῷ’ = ὑπερῷα)
glossary.ὑψαγόρην: ὑψαγόρης — high-talking, big-mouthed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὦπα: ὤψ — face, countenance; neut./fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’as to his face’
glossary.ὦπος: Ὤψ — Ops, father of Eurycleia; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν: ’in his own (mind)’
glossary.αἰγύπτιος: Αἰγύπτιος — Aegyptius, an elder of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἰδέσθητε: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, respect (before others); aor. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.αἰσχύνων: αἰσχύνω — disgrace, bring reproach on, shame; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἴτιοί: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.βασίλευε: βασιλεύω — be king, rule; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβασίλευε)
glossary.γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
glossary.γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.γέροντα: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γέροντες: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.γήραϊ: γῆρας — old age; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρᾳ)
glossary.γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.γλαφυρῷ: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. acc. sg., used collectively: ’tears’ · also elided δάκρυ’ = δάκρυα, neut. acc. pl.
glossary.δήμιον: δήμιος — of the δῆμος, public; neut. acc. sg. (δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’)
glossary.δεδαηκότες: δάω — learn, come to know; perf. part. masc. nom. pl. (δεδαηκώς), with οὐ: ’untaught (in)’
glossary.διαρραίσει: διαρραίω — break in pieces, shatter utterly; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.διόλωλε: διόλλυμι — destroy utterly; perf. 3 sg. intr.: ’is utterly ruined’
glossary.δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg. (purpose): ’might give’
glossary.δοθείη: δίδωμι — give; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg., in tmesis (ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη): ’should be given back’
glossary.δοιά: δοιοί — two, a pair of, twofold; neut. nom./acc. pl. δοιά
glossary.δοκεῖ: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg.: ’he seems’
glossary.δυσμενέοντες: δυσμενέω — be hostile, bear ill will; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δυσμενέων: δυσμενέω — be hostile, bear ill will; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενῶν)
glossary.δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δύναμίς: δύναμις — power, strength, ability; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
glossary.δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.εἰλαπινάζουσιν: εἰλαπινάζω — feast, hold festival; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.εἴθε: εἴθε — would that, if only; particle introducing a wish + opt.
glossary.εἴποι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.εἴσεαι: οἶδα — know; fut. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἴσῃ): ’you will know’
glossary.εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.εἶξαν: εἴκω — give way, yield; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.εἶσι: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg. used with future sense: ’will come’
glossary.εὐνῆφιν: εὐνή — bed; fem. gen. sg., epic case-ending -φι(ν) (= Attic εὐνῆς)
glossary.εὐρύνομος: Εὐρύνομος — Eurynomus, a son of Aegyptius; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θέμιστος: Θέμις — Themis, goddess of custom and right; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic Θέμιδος)
glossary.θέτ: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (θέτ’ = θέτο), in tmesis (περὶ … θέτ’ = περιέθετο): ’set about’
glossary.θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θεσπεσίην: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, more than human (lit. god-uttered); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θηεῦντο: θεάομαι — gaze at, marvel at; impf. 3 pl., Ionic θηεῦντο, unaugmented (= Attic ἐθεῶντο)
glossary.θόωκος: θῶκος — seat, sitting, session; masc. nom. sg., epic stretched form θόωκος
glossary.κέκλυτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., reduplicated (κέκλυτε)
glossary.κέλευσε: κελεύω — order, command; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευσε)
glossary.κέρδεα: κέρδος — gain, profit; neut. acc. pl. κέρδεα, extended sense ’cunning, craft’
glossary.κέρδιον: κερδίων — more profitable, better; neut. nom. sg., comparative of κέρδος
glossary.καθέλῃσι: καθαιρέω — take down, bring down; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι (= Attic καθέλῃ)
glossary.καθίζει: καθίζω — make to sit, seat, convene; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.καθαπτόμενος: καθάπτομαι — accost, address directly, fasten on with words; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κατάνεται: κατάνω — use up, consume (epic = κατανύω); pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is wasted away’
glossary.κατέχευεν: καταχέω — pour down over; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.κειμήλιά: κειμήλιον — treasure, thing laid up in store; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κεχαρισμένος: χαρίζομαι — show favour, gratify; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’welcome, pleasing’
glossary.κηρύκεσσι: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κήρυξι)
glossary.κηρύσσειν: κηρύσσω — proclaim, summon by herald; pres. inf.
glossary.κτεατίσσας: κτεατίζω — acquire, gain possession of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic double σ (κτεατίσσας)
glossary.κυφὸς: κυφός — bent, stooped, hunched; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λήθετ: λήθομαι — forget; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (λήθετ’ = λήθετο), + gen.: ’forgot’
glossary.λίσσομαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. 1 sg., + gen. of the power invoked · also + acc. of the person entreated (and acc. of the thing asked): οὐχ ὑμέας ἔτι λίσσομαι ’I no longer beg you’ · also used absolutely, the addressee already given by context and left unexpressed, with the ground of the appeal in a following clause (λίσσομαι, εἴ ποτέ ...)
glossary.λαέρτῃ: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λαοὶ: λαός — people, host, men of the community; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λεπτὸν: λεπτός — fine, thin, delicate; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λευγαλέοι: λευγαλέος — wretched, sorry, feeble; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λιγυφθόγγοισι: λιγύφθογγος — clear-voiced; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λιπαροῖσιν: λιπαρός — sleek, glistening, glossy (as skin rubbed with oil); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.λυγρῷ: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.λύει: λύω — loose, dissolve; pres. 3 sg. (of an assembly): ’dismisses’
glossary.μέσῃ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; fem. dat. sg. (dat. of place)
glossary.μήδεα: μῆδος — counsel, plan, device; neut. acc. pl. μήδεα
glossary.μίμνετ: μένω — wait, stay, abide; pres. imper. 2 pl., reduplicated stem μίμνω, elided (μίμνετ’ = μίμνετε)
glossary.μαψιδίως: μαψιδίως — idly, heedlessly, to no purpose; adv.
glossary.μενοίνησεν: μενοινάω — intend, be eager for, have in mind; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.μενοινᾷ: μενοινάω — intend, be eager for, have in mind; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.μερμήριξε: μερμηρίζω — ponder, devise, turn over in the mind; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμερμήριξε)
glossary.μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic μετεῖπε)
glossary.μεταμώνια: μεταμώνιος — wasted, vain, gone to the winds; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.μεταστρέψωσιν: μεταστρέφω — turn about, turn back (on someone); aor. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’
glossary.μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας
glossary.μοῖρ: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῖρ’ = μοῖρα)
glossary.μυρία: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. acc. pl. μυρία
glossary.μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μῆνιν: μῆνις — wrath, lasting anger (esp. a god’s); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μῶμον: μῶμος — blame, reproach; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νήματ: νῆμα — thread, spun yarn; neut. nom. pl., elided (νήματ’ = νήματα)
glossary.νεμεσήσῃ: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.νεμεσσήθητε: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic double σ (νεμεσσήθητε)
glossary.νηυσί: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί), here without ν-movable
glossary.οἴκου: οἶκος — house, household; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.οἶκτος: οἶκτος — pity, compassion; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
glossary.πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.πένθεϊ: πένθος — grief, mourning; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πένθει)
glossary.πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν)
glossary.πίονας: πίων — fat, rich; masc./fem. acc. pl. (fem. usually πίειρα)
glossary.παρείη: πάρειμι — be at hand, be present; pres. opt. 3 sg. (remote condition): ’were at hand’
glossary.πατρώια: πατρώιος — of one’s father, ancestral; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πεισήνωρ: Πεισήνωρ — Peisenor, a herald of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεπνυμένα: πέπνυμαι — be prudent, wise (perf. w/ pres. sense, from πνέω ’breathe’); part. neut. acc. pl.: ’prudent (counsels)’
glossary.περίμετρον: περίμετρος — very large, of great compass (περί ’exceedingly’ + μέτρον ’measure’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.περικτίονας: περικτίων — dwelling around, neighbouring; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.περιναιετάουσι: περιναιετάω — dwell around, live in the neighbourhood; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῶσι)
glossary.πιφαύσκεται: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare; pres. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.πιφαύσκομαι: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare; pres. mid. 1 sg.
glossary.ποθ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided before a rough breathing (ποθ’ = ποτέ)
glossary.ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.ποτιπτυσσοίμεθα: προσπτύσσομαι — embrace, press, entreat; pres. opt. 1 pl. mid., epic ποτι- (= Attic προσ-)
glossary.ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’
glossary.ποῖον: ποῖος — of what kind, what sort of; neut. nom./acc. sg., exclamatory: ’what a thing!’
glossary.προγενέστεροί: προγενής — born before, earlier-born; masc. nom. pl. comparative προγενέστεροι
glossary.προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
glossary.προϊεῖσα: προΐημι — send forth, let go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πρόβασίν: πρόβασις — livestock, property that walks (προβαίνω ’walk forward’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πρότερός: πρότερος — earlier, before; masc. nom. sg., adverbial: ’first, before anyone else’
glossary.πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
glossary.πυθοίμην: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.πωλεύμενοι: πωλέομαι — go to and fro, frequent, resort to; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., Ionic πωλεύμενος (εο > ευ)
glossary.πύθοιτο: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.πύματον: πύματος — last, final; neut./masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σπείρου: σπεῖρον — cloth, wrapping, winding-sheet; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.σπῆι: σπέος — cave; neut. dat. sg., epic σπῆϊ (contracted σπῆι)
glossary.στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
glossary.στησαμένη: ἵστημι — set up, set; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having set up (for herself)’
glossary.στρατοῦ: στρατός — army, host; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.σχέσθε: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. imper. mid. 2 pl. (root aor. σχ-): ’hold back, stop’
glossary.τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
glossary.τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τίνα: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., fem./masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τανηλεγέος: τανηλεγής — meaning unknown (traditionally ’laying at full length’ or ’bringing long sorrow’), epithet of death; masc./fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ταφήιον: ταφήιος — for burial, funerary; neut. nom./acc. sg., used as noun: ’burial-cloth, shroud’
glossary.τείρεσθ: τείρω — wear down, distress; pres. inf. pass., elided (τείρεσθ’ = τείρεσθαι)
glossary.τελέσειεν: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may he bring to pass’
glossary.τετεύχαται: τεύχω — make, do, work; perf. pass. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic -νται): ’have been done’
glossary.τοίσδεσσιν: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstr. pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) added (= Attic τοῖσδε)
glossary.τούτους: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τοῖοι: τοῖος — such, of such a sort; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg.
glossary.τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.τόνδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. sg., elided (τόνδ’ = τόνδε)
glossary.τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
glossary.υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
glossary.φάγοιτε: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. opt. 2 pl. (root ἐφαγ-)
glossary.φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
glossary.φήμῃ: φήμη — a saying, utterance heard as an omen; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing
glossary.χάριν: χάρις — grace, charm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χέων: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χαλεποῖσιν: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, severe; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.χρήματ: χρῆμα — thing, matter; pl. χρήματα ’goods, property’; neut. acc. pl., elided (χρήματ’ = χρήματα)
glossary.χρειὼ: χρειώ — need, want, business; fem. nom. sg., epic by-form of χρεία; in τίνα χρειὼ … ἵκει ’whom has need come upon?’
glossary.χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγασσάμενοι: ἄγαμαι — wonder at, be indignant at, resent; aor. part. masc. nom. pl. mid., epic double σ (ἀγασσάμενοι)
glossary.ἀγγελίας: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἀγγελία)
glossary.ἀγορήν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering-place; fem. acc. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγορήσατο: ἀγοράομαι — speak in the assembly; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀγορεύει: ἀγορεύω — speak, speak in assembly; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀγορεύω: ἀγορεύω — speak, speak in assembly; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀγορὰς: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἀγοράς)
glossary.ἀγορὴ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. nom. sg. (Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
glossary.ἀλκήν: ἀλκή — defensive strength, valour; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμείψασθαι: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply, exchange (words); aor. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
glossary.ἀμυνέμεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
glossary.ἀμυναίμην: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid.: ’I would defend myself’
glossary.ἀμῦναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. inf. act., infin. of purpose: ’to ward off’
glossary.ἀνάψαι: ἀνάπτω — fasten on, attach; aor. inf.: ’to fasten (blame) on’
glossary.ἀναπρήσας: ἀναπρήθω — make burst out, blow up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’bursting out (into tears)’
glossary.ἀνσχετὰ: ἀνασχετός — to be endured, bearable; neut. nom. pl., apocope (ἀνσχετά = ἀνασχετά)
glossary.ἀπαιτίζοντες: ἀπαιτίζω — ask back, demand back (epic = ἀπαιτέω); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπερρίγασι: ἀπορριγέω — shudder back from, shrink from; perf. 3 pl. with pres. sense: ’shrink from’
glossary.ἀποτινύμενοι: ἀποτίνω — pay back, exact requital; pres. part. masc. nom. pl. mid.: ’exacting payment (from)’
glossary.ἀπρήκτους: ἄπρηκτος — not to be dealt with, without remedy; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἄπρακτος)
glossary.ἀπώλεσα: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I have lost’
glossary.ἀργοὶ: ἀργός — swift or white (meaning disputed for dogs, both senses possible); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρὴν: ἀρή — bane, ruin, harm; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτέμβει: ἀτέμβω — cheat, disappoint, deprive; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιϊάδων: Ἀχαιιάς — Achaean woman; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω
glossary.ἄγριος: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλγος: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
glossary.ἄντιφος: Ἄντιφος — Antiphus, son of Aegyptius; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄσχετε: ἄσχετος — not to be held back, unchecked (ἀ- + σχετός; epic also ἀάσχετος); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἄτερ: ἄτερ — without, apart from; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl., subject or object of a verb: ’all things’ (τελευτηθῆναι ἅπαντα ’that all things were fulfilled’)
glossary.ἐάσατε: ἐάω — let, allow, leave alone; aor. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’)
glossary.ἐεδνώσαιτο: ἐεδνόομαι — pay/settle the marriage-gifts (ἔεδνα) for a bride; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐθέλοι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐθέλοις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐθελούσῃ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.: ’unwilling’ (οὐκ ἐθελούσῃ)
glossary.ἐκήρυσσον: κηρύσσω — proclaim, make proclamation; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐκτελέσω: ἐκτελέω — finish completely, accomplish; aor. subj. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐμβάλλετε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; pres. 2 pl.
glossary.ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
glossary.ἐπέχραον: ἐπιχράω — fall upon, assail; aor. 3 pl., augment after the preverb (ἐπ-έ-χραον)
glossary.ἐπειγόμενοι: ἐπείγομαι — press on, be eager for, hasten; pres. part. masc. nom. pl. mid., + acc.: ’eager for’
glossary.ἐπερχόμενον: ἐπέρχομαι — come on, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλός: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐσόμεσθα: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic ἐσόμεθα)
glossary.ἐυκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved; masc. acc. pl., epithet of the Achaeans
glossary.ἐύπωλον: ἐΰπωλος — with fine foals, rich in horses; masc./fem. acc. sg. (two terminations; with fem. Ἴλιος)
glossary.ἑσσάμενος: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.: ’having put on (for himself)’
glossary.ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
glossary.ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἔκλυεν: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ἔλπει: ἔλπω — make to hope, cause to expect; pres. 3 sg. act. (mid. ἔλπομαι ’hope’ is more usual): ’keeps in hope’
glossary.ἔμπεσεν: ἐμπίπτω — fall upon, fall into; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνέπεσεν)
glossary.ἔπ: ἐπί — on, upon; standing for ἔπεστι ’is there, is at hand’, accent thrown back (ἔπι), elided ἔπ’
glossary.ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
glossary.ἔρεξεν: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔσκεν: εἰμί — be; impf. iterative 3 sg. (-σκε(ν) suffix): ’used to be’
glossary.ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
glossary.ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold, keep to; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον)
glossary.ἠγείροντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’gathered themselves’
glossary.ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
glossary.ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
glossary.ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
glossary.ἡμετέρη: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἤγειρα: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I gathered’
glossary.ἤγειρε: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἤγερθεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic ἠγέρθησαν): ’were gathered’
glossary.ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
glossary.ἤπιος: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἥρωι: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἦέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj., epic by-form (variant accentuation ἦε)
glossary.ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
glossary.ἦρχ: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἦρχ’ = ἦρχε), + inf.: ’was first to (speak)’
glossary.ἰθακήσιοι: Ἰθακήσιος — man of Ithaca; masc. voc. pl.
glossary.ἰκαρίου: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἱερεύοντες: ἱερεύω — slaughter as a sacrifice, sacrifice; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
glossary.ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἵκει: ἵκω — come upon, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
glossary.ὀλέσσει: ὄλλυμι — destroy; fut. 3 sg., epic double σ (= Attic ὀλεῖ); in tmesis ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει
glossary.ὀλοὴ: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀνήμενος: ὀνίνημι — profit, benefit; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.: ’having got profit, blessed, in luck’
glossary.ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀτρύνοντες: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁμίλει: ὁμιλέω — keep company with, associate with; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + dat. · also pres. imper. 2 sg., + dat., the identical unaugmented form: ’mingle, keep company with!’ (μνηστῆρσιν ὁμίλει)
glossary.ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὄις: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς)
glossary.ὄληται: ὄλλυμαι — perish, be lost, be destroyed; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (μή + subj.: ’lest … perish’)
glossary.ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὑμέας: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; acc. pl., epic ὑμέας (= Attic ὑμᾶς)
glossary.ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
glossary.ὑπίσχεται: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic ὑπίσχομαι
glossary.ὑποδείσατε: ὑποδείδω — fear, shrink before, dread; aor. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ὑψαγόρη: ὑψαγόρης — loud-talker, boaster (ὕψι + ἀγορεύω); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ὕφαινε: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. 3 sg. (an augment on initial υ- does not show in writing)
glossary.ὡπλίσσατο: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare, equip; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic double σ (ὡπλίσσατο): ’made ready for himself’
glossary.ὤρνυτ: ὄρνυμι — stir, rouse; impf. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤρνυτ’ = ὤρνυτο): ’rose’
glossary.ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
glossary.ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
glossary.ῥέζετε: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; pres. 2 pl.
glossary.ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
glossary.αἰετὼ: αἰετός — eagle; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’the pair of eagles’
glossary.αὐγὰς: αὐγή — ray, gleam, light; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship)
glossary.βίοτόν: βίοτος — life, livelihood, substance one lives on; acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.βεβρώσεται: βιβρώσκω — eat, devour; fut. perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’will stand devoured’
glossary.βιότοιο: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γήμασθαι: γαμέω — marry; aor. inf. mid., of a woman: ’be married, be given in marriage’
glossary.γεραιέ: γεραιός — old, aged; masc. voc. sg. (a second word for ’old man’, beside γέρων)
glossary.γνῶναι: γιγνώσκω — know, perceive, recognize; aor. inf.: ’to know, to read (a sign)’
glossary.δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δείδιμεν: δείδω — fear, be afraid; perf. 1 pl. with pres. sense: ’we fear’
glossary.δειρὰς: δειρή — neck, throat; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δεξιὼ: δεξιός — on the right hand, favourable; masc. nom. dual: ’the two, on the right’ (a favourable omen)
glossary.διατρίβῃσιν: διατρίβω — wear away, spend time, delay; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν: ’wears out the time over’
glossary.δρυψαμένω: δρύπτω — tear, scratch, claw; aor. part. mid., nom. dual masc.: ’having torn (with their talons)’
glossary.εἰδῇς: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you may know’
glossary.εἰδῶσι: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 3 pl. with pres. sense: ’they may know’
glossary.εἰσανέβαινον: εἰσαναβαίνω — go up into, march up into; impf. 3 pl., augmented (εἰσ-αν-έ-βαινον; the α of ἀνα- elides before the augment)
glossary.εἴρω: εἴρω (A) — say, tell, declare; pres. 1 sg. (fut. sense: ’I shall say’), distinct from εἴρομαι ’ask’
glossary.εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
glossary.εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — epithet of Zeus, literal sense disputed (’wide-voiced’ or ’far-seeing’); masc. nom. sg. in short -α
glossary.ζώει: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
glossary.θάμβησαν: θαμβέω — marvel, be amazed; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.θεοπροπέων: θεοπροπέω — prophesy, utter oracles; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θωὴν: θωή — a fine, penalty; acc. sg.
glossary.κέλεται: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κέρδεά: κέρδος — gain, profit; (pl.) cunning, shrewd ways; neut. acc. pl., accented before enclitic θ’
glossary.καταπαύσομεν: καταπαύω — stop, put an end to; fut. 1 pl., with κε(ν) in a purpose clause
glossary.καταφθίσθαι: καταφθίνω — perish utterly, be destroyed; aor. inf. mid.-pass.: ’to have perished’
glossary.κείνη: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κεχολωμένον: χολόω — make angry; pass. be angry, enraged; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’in a state of anger’
glossary.κορυφῆς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κυλίνδεται: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’rolls, comes rolling on’
glossary.κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λώιόν: λωίων — better, more advantageous; comparative (of ἀγαθός), neut. nom. sg.
glossary.μέσσην: μέσος — middle; fem. acc. sg., epic μέσσος (doubled σ) = Attic μέσην
glossary.μαντεύεο: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid.
glossary.μαντεύεσθαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.μαντεύομαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.μαστορίδης: Μαστορίδης — son of Mastor, patronymic of Halitherses; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’)
glossary.μνηστύος: μνηστύς — wooing, courtship; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μυθέαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, utter; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic μυθῇ)
glossary.μυθήσασθαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.μυκήνη: Μυκήνη — Mycene, eponymous heroine of the city; nom. sg.
glossary.νεμεσίζεται: νεμεσίζομαι — feel indignation, be ashamed; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.νεμόμεσθ: νέμομαι — dwell in, occupy, inhabit; pres. 1 pl. mid., epic, elided (νεμόμεσθ’ = Attic νεμόμεθα)
glossary.νεώτερον: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νοήματα: νόημα — thought, design, purpose; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.νύκτας: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’by nights’
glossary.οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer only in neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
glossary.οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
glossary.οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.πάντεσσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic πᾶσι)
glossary.πάσχωσιν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.παθόντ: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (παθόντ’ = παθόντα)
glossary.παλαιά: παλαιός — old, of old; neut. acc. pl.: ’things of old’
